mentions.name: HyperServer
mentions.description: A Go framework for building server-rendered web apps with HTMX. It uses standard net/http handlers and html/template, requires no ORM, and makes authentication, sessions, and storage optional. Designed as a reusable library rather than a starter repository to copy; currently labeled experimental, with a functional and fast blog built on it and plans to use it as a platform for other web projects.
mentions.problem: The author liked the architecture and ambition of Pagoda but disliked its dependence on third-party libraries, so HyperServer was built on Go's standard library instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: The second project is HyperServer. HyperServer is a Go framework for server-rendered apps with HTMX that I've been working on off and on for a few years. I was originally inspired by Pagoda and really like the architecture and ambition of Pagoda but didn't like its dependence on third-party libraries.
mentions.author: trentnix
